div.head: IV Eg 1.8
div.ab: ⁊ ic ⁊ mine þegnas wyldan ure preostas to ðan þe ure saula hyrdas us tæcað, þæt syndon ure bisceopas, þe we næfre mishyran ne scylon on nan þara þinga, þe hy us for Gode tæcað, þæt we þurh þa hyrsomnysse, þe we heom for Gode hyrsomiað, þæt éce lif geearnian, þe hy us towemað mid lare ⁊ mid bysene goddra weorca.

⁊ ic ⁊ mine þegnas wyldan ure preostas to ðan þe ure saula hyrdas us tæcað, þæt syndon ure bisceopas, þe we næfre mishyran ne sceolon on nan þara ðinga, þe hi us for Gode tæcað, þæt we ðurh þa hyrsumnysse, þe we heom for Gode hyrsumiað, þæt ece líf geearnian, þe hy us towemað mid lare ⁊ mid bysene godra weorca.

Ipsi quoque cum omni humilitatis subiectione diligenter obaudiant animarum nostrarum custodibus, uidelicet episcopis, quibus incessanter in cunctis iustificationibus obedientes esse debemus, ut illa obauditione, quam eis recte pro amore Diuinitatis inpendimus, eorum doctrinis et bonorum operum eruditionibus ęterne beatitudinis lętitiam a[di]pisci mereamur cum sanctis omnibus.

⁊ ic ⁊ mine þegnas wyldan ure preostas to ðan þe ure saula hyrdas us tæcað, þæt syndon ure bisceopas, þe we næfre mishyran ne sceolon on nan þara ðinga þe hi us for Gode tæcað, þæt we ðurh þa hyrsumnysse, þe we heom for Gode hyrsumiað, þæt ece líf geearnian, þe hy us towemað mid lare ⁊ mid bysene godra weorca.

Und ich und meine Thegnas mögen unsere Priester dazu lenken, was unsere Seelenhirten uns vorschreiben, nämlich unsere Bischöfe, welchen wir nie ungehorsam sein dürfen in einem der Dinge, die sie uns um Gotteswillen vorschreiben, auf dass wir durch den Gehorsam, den wir ihnen um Gotteswillen leisten, das ewige Leben gewinnen, zu welchem sie uns hinleiten durch Lehre und durch Beispiel guter Werke.

And may I and my thegns direct our priests to what the shepherds of our souls teach us, namely our bishops, whom we must never disobey in any of the things that they teach us for God's sake, so that through the obedience which we render them for God's sake we may earn the eternal life to which they lead us by teaching and by the example of good works.

And that I and my thegns shall enforce upon our priests the duties prescribed for us by the guardians of our souls, namely our bishops, whom we ought never to disobey in any of those matters which they, as representatives of God, prescribe for us, so that we, through the obedience which we show them as representatives of God, may inherit the eternal life to which they draw us by their teaching and by the example of good works.

And I and my thegns shall compel our priests to that which the pastors of our souls direct us, namely our bishops whom we should never disobey in any of the things which they prescribe for us for God’s sake, that through that obedience by which we obey them for God’s sake, we may merit the eternal life to which they draw us by teaching and by example of good works.
div.note: F's ‘goddra’ as printed; C ‘godra’.; BF: added from Gesetze I p. 208, October 2026 (MS C (Latin)); O: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Latin version of C)”, now “∅ (moved to BF)”)

note.seg: Mit deutlicher Absicht unterdrückt der Übersetzer die Erwähnung des weltlichen Zwanges, der nach Eg die Priester kirchlich reformieren soll; er begründet vielmehr rein kirchlich den Gehorsam gegen geistliche Vorgesetzte.—Eadgar meint materielle Gewalt; er sagt God hæfð gewyld to minum anwealde Scottas; Birch 1267. Vgl. Gl Kirchenstaatsrecht 24

The translator quite deliberately suppresses the mention of secular compulsion by which, according to Eg, the priests are to be reformed in church matters; instead he gives a purely ecclesiastical basis for obedience to spiritual superiors.—Eadgar means material force; he says God hæfð gewyld to minum anwealde Scottas; Birch 1267. Cf. Gl Kirchenstaatsrecht 24
Die Gehorsamspflicht der Laien gegenüber dem Bischof (s. d. Gl 8a) wird hier auf kirchliches Gebiet beschränkt; anders Gl Kirchenstaatsrecht 2
The laity’s duty of obedience towards the bishop (see that word in Gl 8a) is here restricted to the ecclesiastical sphere; contrast Gl Kirchenstaatsrecht 2
weniað lesen Frühere gegen die Hss. Dies Verb ‘gewöhnen’ kann mit weman ‘locken’ synonym stehen; z. B. to rihte wenian ⁊ weman; Hom. n. Wulfstan ed. Napier 266
Earlier editors read weniað, against the MSS. This verb, ‘to accustom’, can stand as a synonym of weman ‘to entice’; e.g. to rihte wenian ⁊ weman; Hom. n. Wulfstan ed. Napier 266
Der Zusatz der Versio entstammt wohl liturgischer Formel
The Versio’s addition probably derives from a liturgical formula
The reference may be specially to the priests of churches in private hands, cf. II Edg. 2 f.

note.label: that
note.seg: Clerical celibacy is probably meant. Latin omits the mention of interference by laymen with the clergy.
